Notes_and_Tips: Take your thyroid medication on an empty stomach with plain water and wait at least 30–60 minutes before your first meal, if prescribed by your doctor.
Avoid fried foods and choose boiled or pan fried preparations instead.
When stress or late-night cravings occur, drink a glass of water and wait 10 minutes before eating.
Aim for 15–20 minutes of morning sunlight daily. Regular morning sunlight can help support your sleep cycle, energy levels and overall wellbeing.
Practice yoga regularly and include a 30-minute walk on most days to support thyroid health and healthy weight loss.
Drink at least 2.5–3 litres of water daily and maintain consistent meal timings.
